name: Banking
description: Core banking, payments, cards, KYC/AML, and regulatory reporting
rules: Ledger entries are append-only; corrections are reversing entries
AML/KYC datasets access is tightly controlled and logged
Payment settlement must balance debit/credit before gold publish
Regulatory reports (BASEL, local CB) freeze at cut-off with dual control
memories: Card authorization vs clearing timing differences need suspense accounts
ISO 20022 migrations cause temporary dual-format ingest
